privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy of the Hookify platform.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy - Hookify
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Hookify collects, uses, stores, and protects information when you use the Service. By using Hookify, you agree to this Policy.
privacy.s1Operator: Hookify ("we", "our"), operated by VICTOR GOMES MILAZZO LTDA (CNPJ: 48.496.745/0001-10)
privacy.s1Address: Address: Rua Germano Leite, 190, Peluso — Ubá/MG — Brazil.
privacy.s22Title: 2.2 Meta Ads data (Facebook/Instagram) — essential to the Service
privacy.s22Lead: When you connect your Meta account and grant permissions, we process data necessary to deliver the Packs, Manager, Insights, and G.O.L.D. features, including:
privacy.s22Assets: Asset structure and identification (e.g., IDs and names of <f>adaccounts, campaign, adset</f> and <f>ad</f>)
privacy.s22Metrics: Performance metrics (e.g., impressions, reach, clicks, spend, conversions, costs, and derived metrics such as CPM, CTR, CPR)
privacy.s22Creatives: Information needed to display/analyze creatives (e.g., thumbnails, identifiers, and media references such as video/image where applicable)
privacy.s22Quote: We process this data only to provide Hookify's analyses and reports to the user themselves.
privacy.s23Body: If you choose to integrate, we process only the data/columns that you authorize and configure for enrichment (e.g., leadscore, match columns, and dates), to improve analysis and the prioritization of opportunities.
privacy.s24Lead: We may automatically collect technical data for security and operation, such as:
privacy.s24Item: IP address, access date/time, browser/device type, pages accessed, and error events.
privacy.s3Operate: <f>Operate and maintain the Service</f> (import data, calculate metrics, display dashboards, generate insights and rankings).
privacy.s3Support: <f>Support and operational communications</f> (e.g., connection expiration notices, synchronization failures, and relevant updates).
privacy.s3Benchmarks: Aggregated/anonymized benchmarks: we may generate aggregated statistics that do not identify you, your ad account, ads, or creatives, in order to improve the product and the quality of insights.
privacy.s4NoSale: We do not sell personal data or business data.
privacy.s4Providers: With <f>infrastructure providers</f> necessary to operate Hookify (e.g., hosting, database, storage, and logs), subject to confidentiality and security measures.
privacy.s4Legal: For <f>legal compliance</f> or to protect rights and security (e.g., legal orders and fraud prevention).
privacy.s5Cache: We may keep a <f>cache</f> of metrics and processed data for performance, history, and comparisons.
privacy.s5Keep: We keep data for as long as necessary to provide the Service and its features to the user.
privacy.s5Deletion: You may request deletion at any time (Section 8).
privacy.s6Lead: We adopt security measures to protect data, including:
privacy.s6Tokens: <f>Encryption/protection of OAuth tokens</f> stored in the database
privacy.s6Isolation: <f>Logical isolation per user</f> (access control and per-user security policies)
privacy.s6Monitoring: Monitoring and logs for diagnostics and abuse prevention
privacy.s7Body: Hookify is not directed to children under 13 years of age and does not knowingly collect data from children under 13.
privacy.s8Title: 8) Data deletion (User Data Deletion) and revocation of access
privacy.s8Lead: You may delete your data and/or revoke Hookify's access to your connected accounts.
privacy.s8HowTitle: How to request deletion of your Hookify data:
privacy.s8EmailSubject: with the subject "Data Deletion - Hookify", stating the email of the account used on Hookify.
privacy.s8Facebook: <f>Revocation on Facebook:</f> you may remove the app in your Facebook settings ("Apps and Websites"), which revokes our access immediately.
privacy.s8Google: <f>Via Google account (if applicable):</f> you may revoke Google's permission in your Google account settings.
privacy.s8WhatTitle: What happens when you request deletion:
privacy.s8Delete: We will delete the data associated with your account (including tokens and related stored data/caches).
privacy.s8Keep: We may retain only the information strictly necessary to comply with legal obligations, where applicable.
privacy.s8Instructions: You can see detailed instructions here:
privacy.s9Body: We may update this Policy from time to time. The date at the top will be updated whenever there are changes.

deletion.metaDescription: Learn how to request the deletion of your data on Hookify.
deletion.title: Data Deletion - Hookify
deletion.intro: This page explains how you can request the deletion of your data related to your use of Hookify, including data imported from Meta Ads and optional integrations (e.g., Google Sheets).
deletion.s1Title: 1) How to request deletion of your data
deletion.s1Lead: You can request deletion in 3 ways:
deletion.optABodyLabel: In the body of the email: state the email used to access Hookify.
deletion.optAQuote: If you have more than one account, send one email for each (or list all the emails in the same request).
deletion.optBTitle: Option B — Revoke access through Facebook (Meta)
deletion.optBLead: You can remove Hookify's access in your Facebook settings:
deletion.optBNote: This revokes access immediately. If you also want the data stored in Hookify to be erased, use Option A.
deletion.optCTitle: Option C — Revoke access through Google (if you integrated Google Sheets)
deletion.optCLead: If you connected a Google account for spreadsheet integration, you can revoke access:
deletion.optCStep1: Go to the permissions of your <f>Google Account</f>
deletion.optCNote: This stops new synchronizations. To erase data already stored in Hookify, use Option A.
deletion.s2Lead: When we process your deletion request, we will erase the data associated with your account on Hookify, including:
deletion.s2Profile: Your <f>profile</f> data on Hookify (e.g., name, email, and photo where applicable)
deletion.s2Imported: Data imported and stored for analysis (e.g., <f>packs</f>, <f>ads</f>, <f>metrics</f>, caches, and histories associated with your user)
deletion.s2Settings: User settings and preferences on Hookify
deletion.s3Lead: After receiving your request by email (Option A), Hookify will:
deletion.s3Confirm: may send a confirmation that the deletion is complete to the same requesting email.
deletion.s3Quote: We may retain only the information strictly necessary to comply with legal obligations, where applicable.
deletion.s4Lead: If you have questions about data deletion, reach out to us:
